blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–In the last full day of competition in Aichi-Nagoya, Team Philippines makes one final push to improve its medal haul at the 2026 Asian Games on Saturday, October 3. The Blu Girls and the Philippine women’s duo in padel look to salvage podium finishes in their respective bronze-medal matches, while Philippine golfers play in the final round. Filipino athletes will also see action in equestrian, rhythmic gymnastics, rugby sevens, taekwondo and volleyball on Saturday.
